notes:
A general term for items used in everyday life such as toiletries, cleaning supplies, kitchen items, and personal care products. Commonly seen in store signage and shopping contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: daily necessities section (in a store)
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to get one's daily necessities together
- {生活用品|せいかつようひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: providing daily necessities (as aid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧: daily goods — very similar in meaning; ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧ is slightly more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: daily necessities — emphasizes the essential, indispensable nature of the items
- ⟦{消耗品|しょうもうひん}→消耗品：09548_shoumouhin⟧: consumable goods — items that are used up and need replacing, such as tissues or batteries
